games.name: Unboxing Simulator [UPDATE]
games.desc:
🎁 Welcome to Unboxing Simulator 🎁
Smash boxes, uncover legendary loot, and flex your finds with friends!

[How To Play]
• Open boxes to get hats
• Equip your best hats and weapon to boost damage
• Unlock new worlds, hatch pets, and find even stronger hats
• Visit the Trade Plaza to swap epic items with other players
• Equip perks for powerful effects - some spawn extra boxes, others upgrade or even smash them for you

[Tips]
• Bigger gifts = rarer loot - team up for locked crates!
• Reach Area 3 to hatch pets - pets help you find stronger hats from boxes
• A Locked Crate spawns every 15 min - team up to crack it open for random OP loot like perks or potions

Happy smashing and good luck on the loot!
